b: Before adding or subtracting algebraic fractions \( \frac{A(x)}{B(x)} \pm \frac{C(x)}{D(x)} \), factorise all denominators completely to find their lowest common multiple (LCM). For a quadratic inequality \( ax^2 + bx + c > 0 \) with \( a > 0 \) and roots \( \alpha < \beta \), the solution set is the outer disjoint union \( x < \alpha \) or \( x > \beta \); for \( ax^2 + bx + c < 0 \), it is the connected interior interval \( \alpha < x < \beta \).

b: In Pearson Edexcel 4MA1, an arithmetic sequence with first term \( a \) and common difference \( d \) has \( n \)-th term \( u_n = a + (n - 1)d \) and sum of the first \( n \) terms \[ S_n = \frac{n}{2}\left[2a + (n - 1)d\right] = \frac{n}{2}(a + l). \] For composite functions, \( fg(x) = f(g(x)) \) applies \( g \) first and \( f \) second, and values where the denominator of a rational function equals zero must be excluded from the domain.

f: Definition 4.1 — Perpendicular Bisectors & Orthogonal Line Equations
f_ar: تعريف 4.1 — الهندسة الإحداثية ومعادلات الخط المستقيم
b: Given two points \( A(x_1, y_1) \) and \( B(x_2, y_2) \), the midpoint is \( M = \left(\frac{x_1+x_2}{2}, \frac{y_1+y_2}{2}\right) \) and the segment gradient is \( m_{AB} = \frac{y_2-y_1}{x_2-x_1} \). Any line perpendicular to \( AB \) has negative-reciprocal gradient \( m_\perp = -\frac{1}{m_{AB}} \) (so \( m_{AB}\cdot m_\perp = -1 \)), and the perpendicular bisector of \( AB \) satisfies \( y - y_M = m_\perp(x - x_M) \).
b_ar: Given two points \( A(x_1, y_1) \) and \( B(x_2, y_2) \), the midpoint is \( M = \left(\frac{x_1+x_2}{2}, \frac{y_1+y_2}{2}\right) \) and the segment gradient is \( m_{AB} = \frac{y_2-y_1}{x_2-x_1} \). b: For any rational or negative integer power \( y = ax^n \), the derivative is \( \frac{dy}{dx} = anx^{n-1} \). Stationary turning points occur where \( \frac{dy}{dx} = 0 \). In 4MA1 kinematics, if displacement from a fixed origin \( O \) at time \( t \) is \( s(t) \), then instantaneous velocity is \( v(t) = \frac{ds}{dt} \) (the particle is momentarily at rest when \( v = 0 \)) and acceleration is \( a(t) = \frac{dv}{dt} = \frac{d^2s}{dt^2} \).

b: In a histogram with unequal class intervals, the area of each bar is proportional to the frequency, and the vertical axis plots Frequency Density \[ \text{Frequency Density} = \frac{\text{Frequency}}{\text{Class Width}}. \] When items are drawn without replacement from a finite population of size \( N \), the second-stage denominator decreases to \( N - 1 \), and \( P(A \cap B) = P(A)\cdot P(B \mid A) \).
